source_text: Iuravit Dominus: benedicens benedicam; sicut stellae. Haec Homiliae VIII finis de sacrificio Isaac. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Swore Lord: blessing I-will-bless; as stars. These of-Homily VIII end about sacrifice of-Isaac. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord swears: Blessing I will bless you; as the stars >> Bible:Genesis 22:16-17]]. This is Homily VIII’s end on Isaac’s sacrifice. Amen.
